cues.headline: Gaps are opening for Kingsford Rovers

cues.headline: End to end now!

cues.headline: Kingsford Rovers keep losing it at the back
cues.body: Kingsford Rovers have given the ball away 6 times in their own half in the last 5 minutes. Dangerous!

recap.headline: Full time: Kingsford Rovers 2–3 Corrin Bay
recap.summary: A deserved win for Corrin Bay.
